verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI supports extending the agent via configurable MCP servers to add custom tools/capabilities and via GEMINI.md context files to tailor behavior per project, which map to 'custom skills' functionality (gemini-cli-gh-5, gh-19, gh-9, docs-3). However, community reports specifically note GEMINI.md context files are sometimes ignored/hallucinated despite being loaded (gemini-cli-comm-14), undercutting one of the two customization paths. Missing for 10: a first-party 'skills' or plugin marketplace, independent hands-on validation that MCP-based custom tools reliably work as advertised, and resolution of the GEMINI.md reliability complaints.
